_comment: What meshTerm 2.4's (the host Security updates build; docs/plan-host-cve-scanner.md S1) recipes reader does with a recipes file (MeshTermFailures HostRecipes, fr/recipes-v3; docs/recipes-v3-plan.md 2.1-2.2). Read by scripts/compat_check.py; kept honest by meshTerm's RecipesCompatProfileTests, which loads its copy of this file (Packages/MeshTermFailures/Tests/MeshTermFailuresTests/Fixtures/RecipesCompat/) and checks it against the Swift reader. Update both at every app release (docs/recipes-watch.md).

placement._packagesRules: meshTerm S3 review B L3, S4 review L6, S5 app review M2 / L4 (HostRecipeTemplate): packagesByIntent keys are fnmatch patterns. For an intent matching packagesWholeWord the opener must be whole words (it starts the text before {{packages}} or follows a space). For an intent matching a packagesNoInstallWordBefore key, none of its words may appear as a whole word anywhere before {{packages}}, except that an intent named in packagesInstallWordException may end with that exact opener (it is taken off before the check). capitalisedPackageIntents take rpm names (rpmPackageName) in {{packages}}; every other intent the lowercase package name.

reader._idLike: docs/container-idlike-alpine-plan.md (recipes serial 11, serial 12 folded in): the top-level idLike allowlist is read (null = absent; a malformed one refuses the file); the ID_LIKE parent is resolved from the file in use (never for an id any intent names or classifierIds, the Containers family lists in ContainerHostOS.family; otherwise ID_LIKE is walked in order: an allowlisted token is the parent, a familyRoots token off the list stops with no parent, any other token is skipped) and reaches the bundled fallback unchanged; the parent is passed only for the idLikeIntents (HostRecipeIntent.idLikePatterns: the Containers intents in 2.3.2) and resolved per lookup from the host's ID_LIKE (never a kept parent), with the id and tokens trimmed and lower-cased; weights id 8, parent 6 (never with versions), range 2, family 1, any 0; an intent with a versioned variant naming the parent drops only the parent (not an inherited family). parentFamilies (stage C, ContainerHostOS.parentFamilies: classifierFamilies by id): when the parent resolves for a host whose own family is unknown, the lookup takes the parent's recipe family from it, marked inherited (version-only lines then do not match), resolved with the parent from the same file so the kill switch turns it back; a parent with no entry (arch) stays unknown. classifierIds is ContainerHostOS.classifierIDs and classifierFamilies its per-family lists as recipe families (debianIDs -> apt, fedoraIDs -> dnf, alpineIDs -> apk; any other id is unknown), both checked by MeshTermContainerEngine's ContainerHostClassifierTests.

bundled._comment: meshterm-recipes serial 12, an UNPUBLISHED DRAFT (branch serial-12, commit cbf529e, 2026-11-05: b5cc191 plus the server.restart ci.skip reword and the declared-file indent, which the app ignores): serial 11 plus tailscale.update, tailscale.update.detached, tailscale.auto-update, security-updates.apt, security-updates.apk, security-updates.dnf and server.restart. Publish it byte for byte before this build is submitted.

supplies._comment: Placeholders the app fills, per intent, beyond {{sudo}} and {{user}} (always). A recipe using one the app does not pass for that intent renders nil and the app falls back to its bundled line. From the call sites: HostPackageCommands, PendingSetupPresenter, ContainerHostFixes, FirewallCommands, ServerCommands.
